crossRefs.note: After he had eaten bread, and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

translations.web: After he had eaten bread, and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.
translations.bsb: And after the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the old prophet who had brought him back saddled the donkey for him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
